skills.description: 讲解统一错误码结构、HTTP状态码搭配与标准响应体，让错误可定位、可检索、可处理
skills.description_zh: 面向后端开发者的 API 错误码设计指南（免费版）。接口报错如果只返回模糊的"操作失败"或 HTTP 500，客户端无法区分错误类型、无法决定重试还是提示用户，运维也无法快速定位。良好的错误码体系让每个错误有唯一、稳定、可读的编码，并与 HTTP 状态码、结构化响应体配合。本技能讲解错误码设计原则（唯一性、稳定性、可读性、可枚举）、统一编码结构（模块-类别-序号，如 USER-404-001）、HTTP 状态码正确使用（400/401/403/404/409/422/429/500/503）、标准错误响应体（code/message/detail/trace_id）、错误码文档与注册表维护、客户端处理策略（可重试/不可重试）、版本演进与兼容。展示类技能，不含可执行引擎；需要按模块自动生成、去重、解析错误码并构造响应体请用专业版 zsai-api-error-code-pro。
skills.name: API错误码设计指南·免费版

skills.description: 检验“历史结构相似→后续演化相似”：k 近邻无前视匹配、轨迹同质性、状态转移 AUC、去重叠混淆控制。
skills.description_zh: This skill should be used when the user wants to test whether structurally similar historical configurations are followed by similar subsequent evolution in a multivariate time series (macro/relational/exogenous streams, or any feature matrix). It implements the "historical structural-similarity reproduction" method — k-nearest historical analogs under a no-look-ahead constraint, a trajectory-homogeneity statistic, a state-transition AUC, and a disjoint-confound control that rules out mere time-adjacency autocorrelation. It is a structural-analogy / descriptive research tool — explicitly NOT a price predictor and NOT investment advice. This is a paid skill priced at CNY 1.00 per call: the freely downloadable package contains only the method description and the payment script, while the full methodology (a Markdown document) is delivered once by the seller's server after payment is verified, and is returned to the conversation as text. No executable code or engine is ever downloaded, written to disk, or run.
skills.name: 历史结构相似性重现引擎

NOT for: auditing the code a skill calls (skill-clean-audit), a publish-time security/compliance gate (skill-publish-gate), or from-scratch creation (skill-creator). No external network and no required secrets; the linter runs offline.
